document_title: GridSenpAI Planner Required Fields Registry and Pipeline Contract
purpose: Single authoritative field registry for GridSenpAI covering extraction targets, retrieval targets, adjudication inputs, applicant interview prompts, translation, scenario generation, and planner-packet export.
scope_note: This registry is designed to be broad enough for large-load interconnection intake and planner packet preparation for data center projects. It intentionally separates accepted values from alternates, conflicts, and unresolved gaps.
design_principles: One field contract for all pipeline layers.
Equipment identity is first-class and modeled uniformly.
Every field can carry provenance, confidence, and status.
Planner-facing output must preserve uncertainty instead of hiding it.
Retrieval and interview are targeted from the same field registry.
Fields are marked by study relevance and packet visibility.

field_status_contract.export_expectation: Planner packet should show accepted values, alternates, conflicts, assumptions, and unresolved fields separately.

interpretation.high: Direct or strongly corroborated evidence with no material conflict.
interpretation.low: Plausible candidate or weakly supported accepted value requiring planner awareness.
interpretation.unresolved: No value cleared acceptance rules or conflict remains open.
interpretation.moderate: Strong but not yet definitive value, but indirect, inferred, or lightly corroborated.

summary.registry_role: Authoritative field contract for extraction, retrieval, adjudication, interview, translation, scenario generation, and export.

planner_documents.description: Primary utility/ISO intake form for the new stand-alone data center interconnection request.
Stage-by-stage energization schedule with cumulative MW, MVAr, and required transmission upgrade dependencies.
Evidence that the customer controls the proposed site through purchase, lease, option, deed, or equivalent rights.
Maps and layout drawings showing the proposed site, POI options, facility footprint, and major equipment placement.

planner_documents.document_name: Customer One-Line Diagram / Interconnection Single-Line Diagram
planner_documents.description: Electrical topology from the utility interconnection through major buses, transformers, protective devices, UPS blocks, backup systems, and principal load blocks.

planner_documents.document_name: Electrical Load Study and Demand Forecast
planner_documents.description: Engineering study that quantifies peak demand, power factor, MVAr, load composition, and expected operating profile.
Nameplate and configuration details for all interconnection and major facility transformers.
Transformer test results including saturation characteristics where customer-owned transformers are involved.

planner_documents.document_name: Reactive Compensation and Harmonic Mitigation Package
planner_documents.description: Capacitors, reactors, filters, STATCOM/SVC devices, and harmonic mitigation equipment descriptions and settings.
UPS capacity, architecture, operating mode, transfer logic, ride-through behavior, and any vendor model data.
Cooling method, motor inventory, drive methods, and starting characteristics for major motors.

planner_documents.document_name: PSS/E Network and Dynamic Model Package
planner_documents.description: Network representation, dynamic data, user-defined models, and documentation for the data center load.
Detailed PSCAD model and supporting files where SSO or detailed converter interaction studies are required.

planner_documents.document_name: Power Supply / Large Electronic Load Technical Package
planner_documents.description: Representative server power supply information, converter topologies, board photos, schematics, SPICE/equivalent models, and harmonic information.

planner_documents.document_name: Backup Power and Operating Sequence Package
planner_documents.description: Backup generation and/or battery system details, one-lines, controls narrative, switching triggers, and reconnection logic.
Relay settings, transfer logic, ride-through thresholds, reconnection logic, breaker/control schemes, and communications-assisted protection details.

planner_documents.document_name: Telemetry, NOMCR, and Operations Model Package
planner_documents.description: Operations model identifiers, NOMCR tracking, telemetry provider/contact, and evidence of operations-model readiness.

planner_documents.document_name: Standalone Large Load Energization Request Package
planner_documents.description: Final utility/ISO approval package requesting authorization to energize a new stand-alone large load.
